title: Bound runtime fan-out under many dashboard clients
summary: Eliminated repeated Git and repository derivation across concurrent dashboard clients with generation-aware singleflight caching, batched runtime invalidations, visibility-aware event subscriptions, runtime health diagnostics, and private verification lock markers.
userVisibleChange: EVE remains idle when dashboards are open in background tabs and responds to event bursts without CPU spikes or duplicated repository work.

risks.title: Derived state may be briefly stale if a filesystem event is missed
risks.mitigation: Cache entries expire after two seconds, runtime events advance cache generations immediately, and visible/reconnected dashboards perform catch-up invalidation.

timeline.title: Profiled the live CPU spike
timeline.summary: The hot port-4317 runtime was built from a branch with five-second background polling and had thirteen connected dashboards. Stack sampling showed repeated fork, wait4, directory read, and file open work.

timeline.title: Bound request and browser fan-out
timeline.summary: Added generation-aware singleflight caching, coalesced query invalidation, hidden-tab suspension, health diagnostics, and private verification lock markers.

timeline.title: Compared multi-client behavior
timeline.summary: Measured a 95% reduction in 100-client request-wave latency while preserving prompt event-driven refreshes.

decisions.title: Share derived state across request waves
decisions.rationale: Repository summaries, discovery, plan lists, agent activity, and details are expensive and identical across concurrent clients. A two-second generation-aware cache preserves prompt event invalidation while ensuring one load serves an entire wave.

decisions.title: Suspend hidden dashboard event streams
decisions.rationale: Background tabs do not need continuous event processing. They disconnect while hidden and perform one complete catch-up refresh before reconnecting when visible.

decisions.title: Keep transient verification markers out of tracked evidence
decisions.rationale: The active lock marker raced with Git scans and generated tracked-tree activity. Storing it in private Git metadata removes both the race and unnecessary repository events.

validation.output: All packages passed; cmd/eve completed in 38.265s.
Pre-cache event runtime: 3309 ms, 108 threads, about 28 MiB RSS. Optimized runtime: 156 ms, 13 threads, about 11 MiB RSS; 95% lower request-wave latency.

validation.command: Playwright visibility and event burst checks
validation.output: Hidden tab removed its external event subscriber; restoring visibility produced one catch-up wave; ten filesystem changes produced one request per affected query family; browser console had zero errors or warnings.
Private verification marker and drift scenarios passed ten repeated runs.
